links.passage: Multi-source Water systems facilitate the utilization of water from various sources, leading to increased water and fertilizer use efficiency, as noted by Rajakumar et al., 2008.
reference_entries: Rajakumar, M., Kanmani, K. and Prasad, R. 2008. Design and implementation of sensor based irrigation system for agriculture. International Journal of Computer Science and Network Security. 8(12): 117-122.
links.section: Distinctive Features of Automated Irrigation Systems

links.passage: Table 1. Automation of irrigation in maize
supporting_passages: Table 2. Automation of irrigation in chili
(Automation in irrigation S. Rathika et al., 2020)
links.inference_note: Tables 1 and 2, attributed to Rathika et al. (2020), report greater daily plant height and stem diameter for maize and chili irrigated with automation than without, which the paper presents as evidence that automated (micro) irrigation improves crop growth.
reference_entries: Rathika, S., Nandhini, S., Kumar, M. S. and Sujatha, P. 2020. Automation in irrigation system. International Journal of Advanced Research in Engineering and Technology. 11(3): 10-15.

notes: Two-column PDF text is interleaved; passages reconstructed by joining hyphenated lines. Most merit claims (yield, water saving, salinity) carry no citation and were not reported.
